comparison.objective: Place color-coded ECG lead clips at anatomically correct locations, versus tune and lock an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Managing articulated cable chains and placing clips into cups differs from recessed-tool seating, screw torque, fine collar rotation, and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Success requires all three released clips in correct 40 mm cups, at rest, with no wrong placement or pulled lead; the candidate requires two safe locked impact cycles within mechanical limits.
comparison.reason: Both spec versions consistently define cable routing and spatial convention, a meaningfully different tested ability from damper commissioning.
